en.headline: Customs seizes 8.12 million illicit cigarettes in two sea-container cases
en.dek: Officers arrested three local men after finding cigarettes hidden in a container declared as lifeboats from Singapore and another from South Korea declared as toiletries, with a combined estimated market value of…
body: Hong Kong Customs announced on Thursday that it had seized about 8.12 million sticks of suspected duty-not-paid cigarettes in two separate sea-container cases detected at Kwai Chung Container Terminal on 2 and 3 August.

In the first case, officers monitored a 40-foot container from Singapore declared as carrying enclosed lifeboats and rescue boats. On the afternoon of 2 August a 51-year-old local man claiming to be a driver arrived to collect it. Examination found 5.34 million sticks hidden inside wooden crates, with an estimated market value of HK$24 million and duty potential of about HK$17 million. The man was arrested.

In the second case on 3 August, a container from Incheon, South Korea, declared as carrying toothpaste, skincare products and other goods was intercepted. A 42-year-old local driver was stopped on arrival. Officers found 2.78 million sticks wrapped in black material deeper inside the container, valued at about HK$13 million with duty potential of roughly HK$9 million. He was also arrested.

A third local man was later arrested in connection with the cases. The three men, all Hong Kong residents, have been released on bail pending further inquiries. Customs said the seizures highlighted attempts to conceal the cigarettes using legitimate cargo declarations and timing linked to adverse weather.

zh.headline: 海關破兩宗海路私煙案 檢約812萬支拘3人
zh.dek: 關員在葵涌貨櫃碼頭先後截獲由新加坡及南韓抵港的貨櫃，分別以救生艇及牙膏護膚品作掩飾，共檢約812萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，市值約3700萬元。
body: 香港海關周四公布，於8月2日及3日在葵涌貨櫃碼頭偵破兩宗海路貨櫃走私香煙案件，共檢獲約812萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，估計市值約3700萬元，應課稅值約2700萬元，並拘捕3名本地男子。
首宗案件中，關員透過風險評估鎖定一個由新加坡抵港、申報載有封閉式救生艇及救援艇的40呎貨櫃。8月2日下午，一名51歲報稱司機的本地男子到場提貨，人員截查後在木箱內發現534萬支懷疑私煙，市值約2400萬元，應課稅值約1700萬元，隨即拘捕該男子。
第二宗案件於8月3日發生，一個由南韓仁川抵港、申報載有牙膏、護膚品及其他貨物的貨櫃被截查。一名42歲本地司機到場提貨時被截停，關員在貨櫃深處發現以黑色物料包裹的278萬支懷疑私煙，市值約1300萬元，應課稅值約900萬元，司機亦被拘捕。
其後再有一名本地男子因涉案被捕。3名男子現獲准保釋候查。海關表示，不法分子嘗試以合法貨物申報及選擇惡劣天氣時段提貨，企圖減低被發現風險。
